title: BIOLOG tenant access denial audit event
description: ADR-0002 Decision 5, re-profiled onto the audit envelope by ADR-0003 Decision 6.2. A conforming audit-event.schema.json document with outcome DENIED plus one denial-specific field, attempted_tenant_id. Guarantees unchanged: written before the response, both tenants recorded, no payload.

reason_code.description: Reasons an access was refused AND recorded. audit_unavailable is deliberately absent: it is the failure to write an event, so no event carries it.

attempted_tenant_id.description: Tenant that was reached for. Null only when no tenant could be determined at all. Recording it beside tenant_id is the whole signal: without the pair, a cross-tenant attempt is indistinguishable from an ordinary miss.

not.$comment: No payload or embedded record (Decision 3), no aggregate version (append-only, ADR-0001 3.3), no inlined evidence (Decision 5).
